route_details: La2O3 + B4C under high temperature; boron-containing vapor feeds growth

mechanisms.name: kinetic control (supply-limited axial growth)
mechanisms.evidence_snippet: Aspect ratio increases with B-supply and time; lateral growth slower.

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.role: controls B-containing vapor pressure and diffusion rate

effects.mechanistic_rationale: Higher T increases supersaturation; axial growth outpaces radial.
Longer growth extends length more than diameter.
Higher B activity increases axial growth rate.

most_influential_parameter.name: temperature
most_influential_parameter.justification: Primary knob for B vapor pressure and diffusion in carbothermal routes; dominates axial growth vs lateral.
